frozen_representation.rule: average only fully observed frames according to the label-blind efference validity mask

failure_policy: Retain any failed gate. Do not change seeds, F0, dropout fractions, burst size, mask rule, frame/hop, calibration, baselines, or thresholds after execution.
real_io_policy: Real I/O is hard-blocked in the frozen CLI regardless of this result. A pass only permits a separately reviewed and preregistered real-run code change; a failure ends this candidate.
claim_boundary: A pass supports only prospective synthetic plausibility for known self-generated erasure masks. It cannot establish room-transfer robustness, arbitrary-world missingness detection, or close H2.
